faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 3.0 TDV6 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 5. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a Discovery 4 306DT engine fit my Discovery 5?
faqs.a: Not directly. The Discovery 4 and Discovery 5 versions differ in ancillaries, emissions equipment and calibration, so we check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement engine.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 306DT engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 5 3.0 TDV6 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 5 306DT engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo, DPF or AdBlue component, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 306DT engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 3.0 TDV6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery 5 306DT engine replacement take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 306DT?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 5 decide the best approach. Turbo, EGR, DPF, AdBlue and oil cooler faults can often be repaired individually. If the bearings have failed or the crankshaft is damaged, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 5 306DT engine replacement is usually the more dependable choice.
paragraphs: Bearing failures are often linked to oil supply or contamination, so we look beyond the engine itself. Where relevant, we inspect the oil cooler, turbo, intercooler, EGR, DPF, AdBlue system and cooling circuit, and renew the oil, filters and coolant.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 5 3.0 TDV6 Problems
engineProblems.description: The 3.0 V6 diesel often gives warning signs before major failure, so early checks can limit costly damage.

cards.title: Low Oil Pressure and Bearing Knock
cards.description: A knocking noise under load, low oil pressure warnings or metal in the oil may indicate bearing wear that can lead to crankshaft damage. We test oil pressure and inspect the bottom end.

cards.title: Cambelt and Fuel Pump Belt Due
cards.description: The 3.0 V6 diesel relies on belts for its camshafts and high-pressure fuel pump. Overdue belts or tired tensioners can fail suddenly. We check belt condition and service records.

cards.title: Turbo Actuator and Boost Leaks
cards.description: Limp mode, flat performance or boost fault codes may come from turbocharger wear, a sticking actuator or a split intercooler hose. We test boost control and inspect the turbo.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Oil Cooler Cross-Contamination
cards.description: Oil traces in the coolant, coolant in the oil or a creamy residue under the cap may point to a failing oil cooler or seal. We check both fluids and pressure-test the system.

cards.title: EGR and Intake Carbon
cards.description: Rough running, hesitation or EGR fault codes can be caused by carbon build-up in the EGR valves, cooler or intake passages. We test EGR operation and inspect the intake.

cards.title: DPF and AdBlue Warnings
cards.description: DPF lights, regeneration problems, AdBlue messages or a restart countdown may follow short journeys or faults in sensors, pumps or injectors. We read emissions data and test the system.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 5 306DT Engine: Your Complete 3.0 TDV6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 5 306DT engine is the 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to TDV6 versions of the fifth-generation Discovery. Smooth and strong for towing, it is now reaching higher mileages, and bearing damage, belt neglect, turbo faults and DPF or AdBlue problems often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Land Rover 306DT engine was used across several Land Rover and Jaguar models, and later versions differ in emissions equipment, ancillaries and calibration. We identify the correct Discovery 5 3.0 TDV6 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 5 306DT engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
